canonical_example.text: "De tal palo, tal astilla" es un decir popular.
canonical_example.translation: "Like father, like son" is a popular saying.

canonical_example.text: ¡No te enfades, mujer! Es solo un decir.
canonical_example.translation: Come on, don't get annoyed! It's just a manner of speaking.

canonical_example.text: Me dije a mí misma, esto no parece estar bien.
canonical_example.translation: I said to myself, this doesn't feel right.

unused_menu_senses.context: to express a thought to oneself

source_metadata.context: to express a thought to oneself

canonical_example.text: Me sigo diciendo, ¿qué hubiera pasado si hubiera aceptado ese trabajo?
canonical_example.translation: I keep thinking to myself, what would have happened had I taken that job?

unused_menu_senses.context: to express a thought to oneself

source_metadata.context: to express a thought to oneself

canonical_example.text: Senté a mi madre a mi lado.
canonical_example.translation: I sat my mother next to me.

canonical_example.text: Prefiero sentarme al lado del radiador.
canonical_example.translation: I prefer to sit next to the radiator.

canonical_example.text: Sentamos las bases de la cooperación internacional.
canonical_example.translation: We set the foundations for international cooperation.

canonical_example.text: Ese vestido no te sienta bien.
canonical_example.translation: That dress doesn't really suit you.

canonical_example.text: Me gusta el ajo pero no me sienta bien.
canonical_example.translation: I like garlic, but it doesn't agree with me.

canonical_example.text: Deberías pedirle perdón a tu hermana. Tu comentario no le sentó bien.
canonical_example.translation: You should apologize to your sister. Your comment upset her.

canonical_example.text: ¿Por qué no te sientas un rato?
canonical_example.translation: Why don't you sit down for a while?

canonical_example.text: Pronto encontrarás a otra persona y olvidarás a tu ex. Créeme. Sé de lo que hablo.
canonical_example.translation: Soon enough you'll find someone else and you'll forget your ex. Believe me. I know what I'm talking about.

canonical_example.text: En la mitología griega, Zeus crea a Pandora como castigo.
canonical_example.translation: In Greek mythology, Zeus creates Pandora as a punishment.

canonical_example.text: Tus acciones han creado mucha agitación.
canonical_example.translation: Your actions have produced a lot of turmoil.

canonical_example.text: Creó un robot que hace licuados.
canonical_example.translation: He invented a robot that makes smoothies.

canonical_example.text: Has creado muchos problemas para tu pobre mamá.
canonical_example.translation: You've caused your poor mother a lot of trouble.

canonical_example.text: Nuestro jefe creó esta empresa junto con su hermano.
canonical_example.translation: Our boss founded this company with his brother.

canonical_example.text: Antes de crear la compañía, tienen que conseguir un préstamo.
canonical_example.translation: Before setting up the company, you have to get a loan.

canonical_example.text: Han creado un comité para investigar la corrupción dentro del gobierno.
canonical_example.translation: They have established a committee to investigate government corruption.

canonical_example.text: Espérame que yo también voy.
canonical_example.translation: Wait for me, I'm coming too.

canonical_example.text: Espero saber de ti pronto.
canonical_example.translation: I hope to hear from you soon.

canonical_example.text: No espero compasión si me capturan.
canonical_example.translation: I don't expect any mercy if captured.

canonical_example.text: Se esperan cortes en el suministro de agua esta noche.
canonical_example.translation: Disruptions to the water supply are expected tonight.

canonical_example.text: Espera que ya vengo.
canonical_example.translation: Wait, I'm coming.

canonical_example.text: Esperen un momento. Llamo a alguien que los atienda.
canonical_example.translation: Wait a moment. I'll get someone to come and help you.

canonical_example.text: Esperemos a leer el informe antes de decidir qué hacer.
canonical_example.translation: Let's wait until we read the report before deciding what to do.

canonical_example.text: Espérate, ¿no se suponía que ibas a estar fuera un par de semanas?
canonical_example.translation: Hold on, weren't you supposed to be gone for a couple of weeks?
